# GUM365

> GUM365 is the Microsoft 365 user community in Montréal. It brings practitioners together around Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, Power Platform, Copilot, AI, information governance, knowledge architecture and modern collaboration.

Primary editorial language: French Canadian (fr-CA)
English translation: Canadian English (en-CA)
Community and event platform: https://gum365.ca
Source repository: https://github.com/gum365/gum365.github.io

## Main pages

- [Accueil / Home](https://gum365.github.io/): French Canadian home page, community mission and next event.
- [Communauté](https://gum365.github.io/communaute/): Mission, topics and community principles.
- [Événements](https://gum365.github.io/evenements/): GUM365 event formats and live upcoming events from Mobilizon.
- [Partenaires](https://gum365.github.io/partenaires/): Partnership program and ways to support the community.
- [À propos](https://gum365.github.io/a-propos/): About GUM365.
- [English home](https://gum365.github.io/en-ca/): Canadian English home page.
- [Community](https://gum365.github.io/en-ca/community/): English community page.
- [Events](https://gum365.github.io/en-ca/events/): English events page.
- [Partners](https://gum365.github.io/en-ca/partners/): English partnership page.
- [About](https://gum365.github.io/en-ca/about/): English about page.

## Events and community

- [GUM365 Mobilizon](https://gum365.ca): Source of truth for upcoming events, dates, locations, organizers and event pages.
- Upcoming events shown on the Astro site are loaded dynamically from the Mobilizon GraphQL API.
- The Astro site should not be treated as a second source of truth for event details.

## Speaking

- [Sessionize call for speakers](https://sessionize.com/gum365-communitydays-trimestriels/): Session submissions when the call is active.

## Public development

- [GUM365 GitHub organization](https://github.com/gum365)
- [GUM365 website repository](https://github.com/gum365/gum365.github.io)

## Key concepts

- GUM365 means Groupe des Usagers de Microsoft 365.
- The community is based in Montréal, Québec, Canada.
- The brand promise is: Apprendre. Partager. Se rencontrer. / Learn. Share. Meet.
- GUM365 is community-first and practitioner-led.
- Partners support the community but do not control editorial programming.
- French Canadian is the editorial source of truth; English Canadian pages are linked translations.
